children: -- Amid the global shift toward electrification, LEPAS, Chery Auto's all-new NEV brand, is positioned as the "Preferred Brand for Elegant Mobility Life." Built on the purpose-developed intelligent LEX Platform, LEPAS has established its "Elegant Technology" system across core EV technologies, intelligent driving, and electronic and electrical architecture. By translating advanced technologies into composed handling, ride comfort, and comprehensive protection, LEPAS makes elegant driving a tangible part of everyday mobility.
Built for Scalability and Continuous Evolution: Laying the Intelligent Foundation for Elegant Driving

Purpose-developed around elegant driving, the intelligent LEX Platform supports multiple powertrains, including BEV and PHEV, as well as vehicles of different sizes to meet diverse mobility needs across regions and scenarios. The platform features a next-generation electronic and electrical architecture (EEA), built around an integrated domain controller and gigabit automotive Ethernet, enabling rapid detection of driver inputs and precise vehicle control. On the road, the vehicle offers smooth, linear power delivery, precise and consistent steering, and smooth braking with well-controlled body motion, creating a composed and effortless driving experience.

At the same time, the intelligent LEX Platform is designed for continuous evolution. It currently supports Level 2 Intelligent Driving Assistance Systems, with Highway NOA set to roll out within the year. LEPAS models equipped with the Super Intelligent Valet Parking (SIVP) system will be introduced first in select markets, supporting ultra-narrow parking spaces, automated navigation within parking facilities, and rapid parking to address diverse parking needs. Full-domain OTA enables ongoing feature upgrades throughout the vehicle lifecycle, allowing the elegant driving experience to evolve with users' mobility needs.
Technology-Driven Innovation: Bringing Elegant Mobility to the World

To adapt to diverse driving conditions across global markets, the intelligent LEX Platform is calibrated against diverse global driving conditions and further tuned for local markets to balance power, range, and handling, delivering a consistent elegant driving experience worldwide. BEV models feature a highly integrated 12-in-1 electric drive unit, achieving system efficiency of 90.8%. With a cell energy density of 186 Wh/kg, the battery supports fast charging from 30% to 80% in 20 minutes and is capable of operating across an ultra-wide temperature range from -25°C to 55°C, meeting diverse mobility needs. PHEV models, powered by the LEPAS Super Hybrid system, combine smooth power delivery with extended range for confident driving across different environments.

For safety, the intelligent LEX Platform is developed in line with the 2026 Euro NCAP safety standards. For active safety, the ADAS active safety system has been validated across more than 1,200 scenarios, delivering active safety assistance in various conditions, including lane changes, crossing traffic, and low-visibility environments, while the Driver Monitoring System (DMS) has also been upgraded to the 25-point standard. Four-layer redundant unlocking design provides additional protection for users in extreme accidents. The power battery meets both IP68 and IPX9K battery protection ratings, with enhanced thermal runaway protection for tropical, high-temperature, and humid environments to maintain stability and reliability under extreme conditions.

LEPAS's "Elegant Technology" is not about specifications alone, but about delivering stability, reliability, and composure across diverse driving scenarios. LEPAS believes technology delivers real value when it brings greater comfort and ease to every journey. Looking ahead, LEPAS will continue to place "Elegant Technology" at the heart of its products, bringing an exquisite, composed, and elegant mobility experience to users worldwide and redefining quality living in the NEV era.

LEPAS is Chery Auto’s all-new NEV brand, dedicated to creating elegant mobility experiences for users worldwide. Committed to becoming the Preferred Brand for Elegant Mobility Life, LEPAS brings together Leopard Aesthetics, Elegant Technology, and Exquisite Space - transforming elegance into a driving experience you can see, feel, and trust. Supported by a growing global dealer network of more than 500 sales and service outlets, LEPAS is expanding its international footprint through localized operations, delivering products and experiences tailored to users across global markets.
